async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Click the 'Settings' link to go to group settings
    settings_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Settings", exact=False)
    await settings_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Wait a bit for the settings page to load
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Navigate to the members section; look for a link or tab with 'Members'
    members_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Members", exact=False)
    if await members_link.count() > 0:
        await members_link.first.click()
    else:
        # Fallback: try to find by URL pattern or other means
        await page.goto('/groups/x-lab/-/group_members')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Add each member
    members_to_add = ['JonasVautherin', 'dilipchandima', 'dawiss1337', 'bmyun', 'DCMJY']
    for member in members_to_add:
        # Find the 'Add members' button or link
        add_members_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add members", exact=False)
        if await add_members_button.count() > 0:
            await add_members_button.first.click()
        else:
            add_members_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Add members", exact=False)
            if await add_members_link.count() > 0:
                await add_members_link.first.click()
            else:
                # Try to find by text
                await page.get_by_text("Add members").first.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        await asyncio.sleep(1)
        # Fill in the username
        username_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="GitLab member or Email address", exact=False)
        await username_field.fill(member)
        # Select access level, default to 'Developer'
        access_dropdown = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Role", exact=False)
        if await access_dropdown.count() > 0:
            await access_dropdown.select_option('Developer')
        # Click the 'Add to group' button
        add_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add to group", exact=False)
        await add_button.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # After adding all members, return
    return
